retry.note: Retries only on HTTP 429 and 5xx. Copy/ask_susan use short backoff so a Vercel 60s function can finish. Video uses the verified news_video.py schedule.

video.optionalNote: Veo 3.1 ids are on the Gemini API but are not the default. Omni GA handles extension and first/last-frame interpolation. Callers must pass an optional id explicitly; the client never auto-selects Veo.

copy.copyModelNote: Pinned gemini-3.5-flash to preserve SATCOM Video Studio captions/copy behavior (verified still listed 2026-09-29). gemini-3.8-flash is the current recommended Flash and is allow-listed for an explicit upgrade; do not invent ids or use -latest aliases.

ask_susan.note: Health IQ Ask Susan is a separate repo (idigitalpro1/HealthIQ) and is migrated LAST. This workload exists so keys, budgets and logs stay isolated. Never fall back to the video or copy key. Log counts and dollars only — never prompt or response text.

gemini-omni-1.1-flash.note: Paid tier only. 1080p and 4k are upscaled; the pricing page does not list a separate 1080p rate. Estimate 1080p at the 720p token rate.

gemini-3.8-flash.note: Standard paid prices through 2026-12-31, then $1.50 / $7.50 per 1M tokens.

veo-3.1-generate-preview.note: Optional. Not the default video path.

veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview.note: Optional. Not the default video path.

billingAccount.note: Patrick's Gemini consumer / Google AI Studio subscription does not cover Gemini API charges. Set a hard cap on the Google Cloud billing account and per-project budgets. In-app daily/monthly caps are a second line of defense only and cannot stop a leaked key.

omni.resolutionSwitch: Docs disagree: the API reference puts resolution on VideoResponseFormat (response_format.resolution); the changelog mentions generation_config.video_config. Switch omni.resolutionPath to the alt value if a live call rejects the reference path. Do not send both.
omni.synthidNote: This video was generated by Google Gemini Omni Flash. All Google AI generated videos carry an invisible SynthID watermark for provenance. Label it as AI-generated wherever it is used.
